Each of the three corrected full triples was separately displayed and reread. The author then separately reread all six final complete triples and freshly refetched/rehashed all nine retained books again. All other original full-triple readings remain applicable. Supplemental necessary context in Romans 11, Jonah 4, Luke 9, and 2 Chronicles 20 was read in full bounded displays. Final independent root peer acceptance is recorded separately and must bind these final bytes. The existing finalizer exact same-chapter gate subsequently required literal same-chapter markers. Preserved the six-semantic-change intermediate TSV, receipt, and exact stage as separate byte-identical historical artifacts.
